interface.name: jwm_remote_popup_manager_v1

description.summary: explicit trusted-local root and popup interaction

interface.description: Private opt-in capability, not an unrestricted virtual pointer or a portal. Binding the manager grants no input authority. Creation is a single attempt against an exact live selected root owned by its application client. Existing read-only derived sources cannot be upgraded. The root family is consumed for other input grants. A capture source exported from the lease belongs to that lease and does not grant input independently.

interface.name: jwm_remote_popup_lease_v1
interface.description: The original 30-second budget starts at creation, not at arm. The independent seat is visible only to the selected root application client. The application must actually bind its pointer before arm can succeed; clients that do not support this seat are rejected without a main-seat fallback. This protocol does not promise general toolkit or dynamically added seat compatibility. Captured content stays clipped to the fixed root canvas. Only authorized same-client popup targeting is limited to at most one direct child of the selected root; nested popups and siblings are not authorized. Admission requires the dedicated seat's valid popup-grab serial before first mapping. A changed capture proof does not grant authority to a new popup. Lock, local takeover, root lifecycle invalidation, disconnect or invalid requests revoke the lease. No keyboard, scroll, drag, independent button edges or global input is granted.

request.name: get_capture_source

description.summary: export the frozen capture authority exactly once

request.description: Creates the capture source from the family authority frozen by create_lease. This request is allowed only once per lease. It does not select a new root, create a new input grant, renew expiry or reset a consumed authority. An invalid or repeated request must fail closed; no replacement source is granted. Arming requires a successful frame from this exported source.

request.name: arm

description.summary: arm against a real captured root proof

request.description: Requires the exact epoch and a fresh successful frame for this lease's capture source, plus the application's actual pointer receiver. The trusted host must first verify actual presentation. This is a trusted-host obligation, not a presentation check implemented by this native protocol; the initial native-only slice has no end-to-end viewer verification. Arming freezes the receivers and establishes root pointer focus; it does not extend the original expiry.

request.name: action

description.summary: consume a fresh presentation-bound input opportunity

request.description: Each action requires a new same-source frame rendered after the previous action, no older than one second, and verified as actually presented by the trusted host. Root-canvas coordinates are checked against the captured target snapshot. Changed popup identity, geometry or stacking invalidates stale targeting. Sequences increase strictly within the original epoch. accepted reports input dispatch, not application completion or persistence.

arg.name: kind
arg.summary: 0 motion, 1 atomic left click; all other values rejected
